fuss.definition:
1. an excited state of agitation
2. an angry disturbance
3. a quarrel about petty points
4. a rapid active commotion

future.definition:
1. yet to be or coming
2. effective in or looking toward the future
3. (of elected officers) elected but not yet serving
4. a verb tense or other formation referring to events or states that have not yet happened
future.examples:
some future historian will evaluate him
he was preparing for future employment opportunities
our next president

future.definition:

2. a verb tense that expresses actions or states in the future
3. bulk commodities bought or sold at an agreed price for delivery at a specified future date
future.synonyms: hereafter; futurity; time to come; future tense

future date.definition: a particular day in the future that is specified as the time something will happen

future perfect.definition: a perfective tense used to describe action that will be completed in the future
future perfect.examples: ‘I will have finished’ is an example of the future perfect

future perfect tense.definition: a perfective tense used to describe action that will be completed in the future

futures contract.definition: an agreement to buy or sell a specific amount of a commodity or financial instrument at a particular price on a stipulated future date; the contract can be sold before the settlement date

futures exchange.definition: a commodity exchange where futures contracts are traded

futures market.definition: a commodity exchange where futures contracts are traded

futurism.definition:
1. an artistic movement in Italy around 1910 that tried to express the energy and values of the machine age
2. the position that the meaning of life should be sought in the future

futurist.definition:
1. a theologian who believes that the Scripture prophecies of the Apocalypse (the Book of Revelation) will be fulfilled in the future
2. someone who predicts the future

futuristics.definition: the study or prediction of future developments on the basis of existing conditions

futurity.definition:
1. the time yet to come
2. the quality of being in or of the future

futurology.definition: the study or prediction of future developments on the basis of existing conditions

fuze.definition: any igniter that is used to initiate the burning of a propellant
